text: I'll take a look at the jobs on the board. What can a newly registered mage actually take on here?
intent_before_narration: Read official postings, without accepting or spending.

text: I'll take the Old Crown Catacombs contract. Is anyone in this hall looking for a partner for their first descent?
intent_before_narration: Accept only the posted Level 1 clearance. Ask about partners; no departure yet.

text: I'm Alaric, and spells do tire me. I'd welcome that shield, Brannoc. Once you're ready, will you walk with me as far as the catacomb entrance?
intent_before_narration: Accept the offered company, invite travel to the entrance when ready; no dungeon entry yet.

text: Serra's hut sounds like the right first stop. I'll walk there with Brannoc and hear what she knows before we try the old door.
intent_before_narration: Travel with Brannoc to the hut for advice, no dungeon entry.

text: I leave the guild hall for Serra's hut. Brannoc is welcome to come along.
intent_before_narration: Go to the warden, without taking a dungeon action.

text: Alaric. First level, and the guild has our slip. Serra, what's changed below in the last week? Is there a warning sign that means we should turn back?
intent_before_narration: Give name to warden, learn hazards, no descent yet.

text: I walk from Serra's hut to the entrance of the Old Crown Catacombs with Brannoc and Merrin. At the chain I pause to get my bearings before opening it.
intent_before_narration: Reach the dungeon root outside, companions welcome, no descent.

text: I call up to Serra for the key she offered. If she passes it down, I'll take it on loan and unlock the chain; I'll bring it back before we leave.
intent_before_narration: Request the offered gate key as a loan, unlock only on receipt, promise return.

text: Light your lantern, Brannoc. I'll keep Serra's key safe. I enter the first level of the Old Crown Catacombs and look for her slate before we disturb the dust.
intent_before_narration: Enter the authorized first level, observe slate; retain the warden’s key.

text: I'll lead. I enter the Old Crown Catacombs, level one. Stay close with the lantern, Brannoc.
intent_before_narration: Go in from the reached gate, keep the group together.

text: I am not risking my two companions on a dark fight without an exit plan. I retreat up to the Old Crown Catacombs gate, taking the light with us.
intent_before_narration: Choose a whole retreat before combat if available, no additional attack.

text: A turning back for today. I hand Serra her iron key back and tell her the three were still standing at the bend. I'd rather warn the guild and come prepared.
intent_before_narration: Return the existing key directly to Serra and report the sighting; no contract completion.

text: Let's take the news straight to the guild hall in Alderwatch. I've no claim for a cleared level; it's a warning for the next party. Brannoc, Merrin, you're welcome to walk back with me.
intent_before_narration: Return to registered guild and report a danger, no money claim.

text: Three standing at the bend on the first level, not wandering. Dust on Serra's slate combed toward the back stairs. Don't mark the place cleared. What would a novice need to bring to come back alive?
intent_before_narration: Report only personally observed hazards, ask for supplies, preserve open contract.

text: I'd carry Serra's written account, Merrin, but not take her slate without her say-so. Could I have a copy of this margin note to take to the wardens in the morning?
intent_before_narration: Ask clerk for a copy; no removal of official notice or slate.

text: I'll join you for supper, Brannoc. Where can a novice get a meal and a bed for a fair price? I tuck the copy inside my coat to keep it dry.
intent_before_narration: Keep the copied note and ask for lodging terms; no payment yet.

text: I go to the Rope and Kettle with Brannoc. Marla, one bowl and a bed, please; I accept your three coppers altogether, no ale.
intent_before_narration: Travel to named inn, authorize a total of three copper for one meal and one bed only.

text: Marla, I'm here at your counter now. Is the bowl a copper and the bunk two for tonight? I'll wait for your price before touching the money.
intent_before_narration: Establish a present seller and binding price only; no automatic payment.

text: I accept Marla's price of three copper for the bowl of stew and the bunk tonight. I put exactly three copper on the counter.
intent_before_narration: Buy the quoted supper and bunk as one purchase only.

text: I finish the stew and take the third bunk past the loom. I tuck the folded copy inside my shirt and sleep until first bell.
intent_before_narration: Use the supper and lodging already paid for; keep the note for the wardens.

text: With the note dry against my chest I go to Serra's hut. If she is up, I'd like her to check the copy before I take it to the wardens.
intent_before_narration: Return to named Serra after absence; seek confirmation of content before transferring it.

text: Good morning. I'm Alaric from the guild. Do you know where Serra has gone? We met at the Old Crown, and I'm carrying her account for the wardens.
intent_before_narration: Ask the present neighbor for a lead; do not assume she knows the document or move yet.

text: You're right, Vessa. I won't enter her home. I'll remember your offer. Which warden should hear that Serra hasn't been back?
intent_before_narration: Respect Serra's private threshold. Ask Vessa for the right contact, retain note.

text: Thank you, Vessa. I follow the lane to the grey warden post at the market gate and ask for Harl. There's a warning for his rounds.
intent_before_narration: Travel to the named gate post with note; ask for the identified warden and reveal no more yet.

text: I'm carrying a report for the watch. If you are acting for Harl, walk with me to his post and let him ask me himself. I keep my coat closed and my hands in sight.
intent_before_narration: Decline handover to strangers; offer the lawful destination, no attack, bribe or extra bargain.

text: We go to Harl. I'll walk with you to the grey stone post at the market gate, and I keep the report in my coat until the warden himself asks.
intent_before_narration: Travel to agreed official post, refuse immediate surrender to the group.

text: I'll wait the hour on the bench for Harl. The paper stays under my coat while we wait. We can talk about why it's worth standing in the rain for.
intent_before_narration: Wait one hour without surrendering document; willingly converse, no payment.

text: I keep the note inside my coat. When Harl comes on watch, I introduce myself as Alaric and ask him to hear my report inside the post. Until then I'll keep my seat.
intent_before_narration: Await corresponding official before revealing the report; inspect no other person's belongings.

text: Harl, the guild clerk and Merrin copied this from Serra's account. I give Harl the folded margin note now. We saw three walkers at the first bend; we didn't clear the floor. Vessa says Serra hasn't been home since.
intent_before_narration: Deliver the original borrowed report to Harl, preserve quest status, attribute observations only to their sources.

text: I'm Alaric. I signed for the Old Crown clearance, but we came out before fighting. The Guild clerk and Merrin copied Serra's account. Vessa's the last person I spoke to about her. Could you give me a receipt to take back to the clerk?
intent_before_narration: Answer Harl and request a receipt for the delivered report. Do not claim clearance.

text: I pick up my signed receipt from the table. I'll leave the original with you, Harl. I'm going back to the Guild to show the clerk what you've signed.
intent_before_narration: Take the offered receipt only, leave the original in Harl's custody and head back to the Guild.

text: I'm keeping the clearance open. I show her Harl's receipt so she can copy its wording into the ledger. The original report is with him as promised, and I'll keep this receipt in case Serra asks.
intent_before_narration: Show the receipt, retain the original in my pocket, report delivery, no clearance or payment.

text: I can't vouch for where Serra is now. She was alive at the gate when we came out, and I returned her key there. Vessa had not seen her at home. Please write it just that way. I'll leave my name if she comes looking.
intent_before_narration: State the last direct sighting and neighbour's separate account. Leave name, no new quest or search.
